channel.title: 0xAbhiram Blog
channel.description: 0xAbhiram Blog — Product Security Engineer Abhiram SS writing on red teaming, Active Directory, Kerberos, and GRC automation.

item.title: Kerberos Attacks: How Identity Tickets Become Paths Through Active Directory
item.description: A red-team mental model of Kerberos: how TGTs and service tickets work, why Kerberoasting and AS-REP roasting exist by design, and the controls that actually reduce the blast radius.

item.title: How My Team Uses Claude to Automate GRC Work — TPRM Sheets, Security Questionnaires, and Shared AI Workflows
item.description: How we use Claude Cowork to automate TPRM questionnaire responses — cutting completion time from 4 hours to 30 minutes with policy-grounded, consistent answers.

item.title: Active Directory Fundamentals: Architecture, Identity, and How AD Really Works
item.description: A foundational red team–oriented breakdown of Active Directory architecture, identity flows, and trust relationships that attackers abuse in real-world enterprise compromises.

item.title: Red Teams Don't Hack Systems — They Hack Trust
item.description: A deep analysis of why real-world compromises succeed by abusing trust assumptions rather than exploiting isolated vulnerabilities.
